author: claude-fable-5
hypothesis_text: The network_spillover family's post-2024 negative IC is explained by exactly one of: (a) cyclical crowding, (b) regime interaction (real rate / USD trend / dispersion / EM-DM flows), or (c) construction drift in the nightly rebuilds.
gate_ladder: Step(i) drift: frozen-vintage vs recompute corr>=0.95 + PIT/non-PIT + constant-universe slices; Step(ii) regime: C1 FDR-significant axis pre-2024 AND C2 counterfactual predicts the bad spell beating 95% of placebo AND C3 observed within 90% CI; Step(iii) crowding: S1 inflow build-up z>=1 2021-23 with reversal AND S2 losses concentrated in high-inflow half; else INCONCLUSIVE -> R-A price gate.

gate_results: (c) drift REJECTED: recompute-vs-frozen family IC corr 0.996; PIT and non-PIT variants both flip; constant-universe still flips; coverage flat 2023 vs 2025
(b) regime REJECTED: no axis FDR-significant pre-2024 (best NW-t 1.29); counterfactual predicts +0.031 vs observed -0.011 (outside 90% CI); only 72% of placebos beaten
(a) crowding NOT CONFIRMED: S1 FAIL (2021-23 inflow z +0.15, need >=1.0); S2 weak pass (-0.91% vs -0.70%/mo)
lesson: The flip is real (family IC +0.023 NW-t 4.0 2012-23 -> -0.012 post-2024, LS break 2024-04), market-based, state-independent; slow horizons died first; the walk-forward combiner degraded last (negative only 2026H1). Default action: R-A price gate (two consecutive positive family month-ends re-arm). Lag-1 addendum (a6): ~half the pre-2024 measured IC was same-close/timezone echo (lag-1 pre +0.012 NW-t 2.2); the reachable half is what went negative.

author: claude-fable-5
hypothesis_text: Scaling the daily combiner LS book's gross exposure inversely to smoothed cross-sectional dispersion improves risk-adjusted and drawdown-adjusted returns without selling skew (R1 of regime3_candidates.md).
gate_ladder: G1 Sharpe delta >= +0.10; G2 shallower MDD; G3 monthly skew loss <= 0.10; G4 beats identical-shape vol-target control by >= 0.05; G5 beats 95% of 500 circular-shift placebos. ALL required for ALIVE.

gate_results: G4 FAIL: does not beat vol-target control (+0.04 < +0.05); control itself useless (skew -> +0.57)
G5 FAIL: beats only 78.8% of placebos

CORRECTION (Arjun challenge, same day): originally-reported levels (Sharpe 3.26 gross) were a lag-0/1d-hold paper construct at asynchronous local closes (execution fantasy + timezone echo). Decomposition: lag0/1d 3.27 -> lag0/5d 1.76 (matches harness 1.774) -> lag1/1d 1.06 -> lag1/5d 0.97. DEAD re-confirmed on the realistic lag-1 book (delta -0.061, skew still down, loses to vol-target).
lesson: Inverse-state gross throttles (dispersion OR own-vol) on positively-skewed cross-sectional LS books sell convexity and buy nothing - replicates the AA engine vol-conditioning rejection on a second engine class. ALSO: harness lag-0 ICs are a measurement device; portfolio LEVELS from lag-0 books are never results.

author: devin-agent
hypothesis_text: A pre-specified pooled nonlinear model — depth-2 histogram boosting (max 4 leaves) on a fixed 15-input economic representation S — will predict 20-local-session forward USD country equity returns better than independently tuned ridge models on the same 21 raw primitives (L_X), the same S inputs (L_S), and their annual inner-selected combination (L_star), on an identical point-in-time-safe eligible sample. The claim is about pooled nonlinear STRUCTURE, not any single primitive; the graveyard already holds the individual primitives DEAD as standalone signals, which is expected and not a conflict. PRIOR EXPOSURE DECLARED: MacroState M_20260906_001-003 (same idea family, different monthly/12M contract, no nested PIT inference; its nonlinear stage was designed after earlier results were seen), the LLM-1M tabular HGB arm, and the T2 IPCA pooled-model experiment. This study is not fresh confirmation of any of them. Amendment AM-1 (dropped P07/P08 bank-neighbor primitives and the nonexistent P11 3M risk reversal; 21 primitives, 15-input S, 22-market universe) was approved before any result exposure. A valid negative result is a successful delivery.

gate_ladder.description: Pre-execution integrity: P01-P05 phase gates PASS and all registered hashes verify against on-disk artifacts (validate-registration must pass)

Inference calibration: empirical familywise rejection rate of the 63-origin block-bootstrap/Holm engine on 100 fixed null replications has 95% Wilson lower bound <= 5% nominal (else INVALID_INFERENCE_CALIBRATION)
Positive control: the full nested selection procedure detects the planted C04*C06 interaction at moderate variance share (q>=0.005) at a non-trivial rate across >=100 fixed replications
Primary MSE: N_S outer origin-weighted MSE gain vs BOTH L_X and L_S >= 0.1% relative, Holm-adjusted significance over the primary family
Primary IC: N_S outer IC gain vs L_star >= 0.01, Holm-adjusted significance over the primary family
